# External build dependencies

Place third-party build/runtime files here locally before running the PyInstaller build. This directory is intentionally ignored by Git.

Required for the native Windows build:

```text
wInd3x-win.exe
libusb-1.0.dll
```

Optional compatibility/driver files:

```text
wInd3x
wInd3x-write-musl
zadig.exe
```

Sources:

- wInd3x: https://github.com/freemyipod/wInd3x
- libusb: https://libusb.info/
- Zadig: https://zadig.akeo.ie/
